summary: Your fourth Sunday review, about words. You answer 8 questions in your own words (feature, label, three piles, baseline, overfitting, the hidden test set, the loader), build a one-line glossary, group your confusions into 3 themes, tag week 4 and plan week 5.
goal: Explain the data and machine learning words from this week in your own words, and plan week 5.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions in your own words with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Glossary: write a one-line definition and an example for 7 words, without notes
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Catch up: tick every unfinished step of Day 22 to Day 28, in order
Run git tag week-4 and see tag: week-4 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 5: write one outcome sentence, put 7 sessions in your calendar, and write your drop list
Play the Week 4 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
